fields.description: Operators can now manually trigger a SAME monitoring cycle directly from the Ops Command Center using a new 'Execute Now' button. The button provides real-time status feedback (queued, running, completed, failed) with automatic polling, execution duration tracking, and full audit logging. An idempotency guard prevents duplicate triggers while a cycle is already running. All executions — both manual and scheduled — are now tracked in a dedicated execution log with trigger source, timing, and outcome metadata.

fields.title: Celery + Redis Background Infrastructure
fields.description: The system monitoring engine (SAME) has been migrated from an in-process scheduler to a dedicated Celery worker backed by Redis. This means monitoring continues running even if the web server restarts, with automatic retry on failures, configurable timeouts, and proper task queue management. The existing database lock still prevents duplicate execution. This is infrastructure-only — no changes to monitoring behavior or the Operations Wall interface.

fields.title: Ops Command Center Evolution — Full Intelligence OS
fields.description: The Operations Wall has evolved into a full Intelligence Operating System with 5 major upgrades: (1) SAME engine now runs autonomously in the background every 60 seconds — no more depending on someone having the page open. (2) A new System Integrity Index scores overall platform health 0–100 with a color-coded tile showing OPTIMAL/NOMINAL/DEGRADED/CRITICAL posture. (3) Anomalies now escalate automatically — P3 issues promote to P2 after 10 minutes, P2 to P1 after 20 minutes, with cooldown logic to prevent flapping. (4) Each engine card shows a 30-minute cadence timeline strip with expected ticks, actual runs, and highlighted missed intervals. (5) Low-severity anomalies on background engines (DBE/WIRE/DNE) can now be auto-remediated — missed runs get re-triggered and suppression caches get cleared automatically, all logged with full audit trail. 82 tests cover all new functionality.

fields.title: Operations Wall Upgraded to Vegas v2
fields.description: The admin Operations Wall has been completely rebuilt with a NASA/SOC-grade dark monitoring interface. A new System Autonomous Monitoring Engine (SAME) watches all 10 intelligence engines in real-time — detecting missed runs, error spikes, suppression storms, and more — then narrates what's happening in plain English. Engine heartbeats track expected vs actual cadence, anomalies persist with full lifecycle tracking, and admin actions (re-run engine, clear caches, acknowledge alerts) are fully audited. The wall shows system posture (OK/DEGRADED/AT_RISK), engine cards with sparklines, a live watchlist, and a scrolling SOC feed. 42 new tests cover the full stack.

fields.title: Monica's Intelligence Gets Sharper and More Self-Aware
fields.description: Monica's decision-making system (UAL v2.1) has been hardened with five new capabilities: she now tracks whether you've been ignoring her suggestions and adjusts accordingly (instead of nagging), avoids repeating similar nudges within hours, adapts her communication style based on your current capacity (simple and gentle when you're depleted, strategic when you have bandwidth), recognizes when persistent patterns need a different approach rather than repeating the same advice, and detects when your capacity has been volatile to dial back confident recommendations. All of this happens silently in the background — you'll just notice that Monica feels more perceptive and less repetitive.

fields.title: Engine Diagnostics Console + Operations Wall
fields.description: Admin-only observability upgrade: every intelligence engine now emits trace-level diagnostics (EngineRun, EngineSpan, DecisionRecord) correlated by trace ID. The Diagnostics Console (/admin-console/diagnostics/) shows live traces, waterfall detail, and search. The Operations Wall (/admin-console/ops/) is a Vegas-themed live monitoring dashboard with engine pulse tiles, cognitive feed, anomaly detection (error bursts, suppression spikes, scenario dominance, delivery storms), and trend charts. Deep links connect the two layers. 67 tests cover the full stack.

fields.title: Monica Now Makes One Decision, Not Ten Suggestions
fields.description: Monica's intelligence system now includes a Universal Arbitration Layer that evaluates all of your signals — sleep, medication, mood, schedule, relationships, goals, and more — and decides the ONE most important thing to focus on right now. Instead of listing 8 separate reminders, she now tells you a unified story: 'You're running on 5 hours of sleep with a packed schedule — today is about protection, not production.' She'll surface a maximum of 3 items and suppress competing signals, so every interaction feels decisive and human.

fields.title: Monica Now Greets You Like a Real Chief of Staff
fields.description: Monica's morning greeting has been completely upgraded. She now reviews your sleep, checks if you've taken your medicine, surfaces approaching birthdays and life events, scans your journal for patterns, and presents your day as a narrative — not a data dump. If you've been away for a few days, she'll catch you up on what shifted. She also now remembers conversation topics beyond the last 15 messages through rolling memory summaries. This is the executive arrival experience — proactive, aware, and human.

fields.title: Monica Now Proactively Checks In With You
fields.description: Monica is now a true Chief of Staff. She'll proactively reach out in the chat to ask about missed medicine doses, remind you to work out or journal, flag overdue tasks, warn you about busy days ahead, share pattern observations from your data, and note birthdays and anniversaries. No more waiting for you to ask — she's watching your data and speaking up when something needs your attention.

fields.title: Apple Watch Workout Display — See Your Full Activity Data
fields.description: Workouts synced from your Apple Watch (like Pickleball, Running, Cycling) now display properly! Instead of showing '0 Exercises / 0 Sets', you'll see the real activity data: duration, calories burned, distance, average heart rate, and start/end times. The workout list also shows a quick summary like '45 min • 320 cal • 142 bpm'. Look for the Apple Health badge on synced workouts.

fields.title: Password Visibility Toggle
fields.description: You can now tap the eye icon next to any password field to show or hide your password as you type. Available on the sign-in page, sign-up page, change password, reset password, and anywhere else you enter a password.

fields.title: Sleep Tracking Fix — No More Fake 8-Hour Readings
fields.description: If you saw uniform 8.0-hour sleep entries tagged 'Apple Health' every night, those were false readings. Heart rate data from your Apple Watch was accidentally creating dummy sleep records. This has been fixed — heart rate data no longer generates fake sleep entries, and all existing dummy entries have been removed. Your sleep page will now only show real sleep data that you log manually or that comes from an actual sleep tracker.

fields.title: Your Chief of Staff Can Now See All Your Health Data
fields.description: Previously, your Chief of Staff could only access weight, fasting, workouts, and medication data. Now Monica can see your steps, sleep, heart rate, blood pressure, glucose, blood oxygen, mobility metrics, heart rate events, audio exposure, and dietary nutrients — everything your Apple Watch and Health apps are syncing. Ask about your step count, sleep trends, heart rate, or any health metric and get real answers backed by your actual data.

fields.title: Food Search & Barcode Scanner — Now With Real Data
fields.description: Food logging just got a major upgrade. Typing a food name now searches the FatSecret database of 1.9 million foods including full restaurant menus — type 'Chick-fil-a' to see the whole menu, or 'Chick-fil-a nug' to narrow it down. The barcode scanner is also more accurate: it now requires multiple consistent reads before accepting a barcode, eliminating false matches. All three search tiers are active: your saved foods first, then FatSecret's database, then AI estimation as a fallback.

fields.title: Extended HealthKit Integration — Your Watch Tells Us More Now
fields.description: Your Apple Watch and Health data now syncs 37+ data types to WLJ, up from 24. New categories include: Mobility & Gait (walking asymmetry, steadiness, speed, step length, stair performance — strong predictors of long-term health), Heart Rate Events (high/low HR alerts and irregular rhythm/AFib detection from Apple Watch), Audio Exposure (headphone and environmental noise levels for hearing health), and Dietary Nutrients (calories, protein, carbs, fat, fiber, and more — automatically pulled from food-logging apps like MyFitnessPal that sync through Apple Health). Your Chief of Staff can now detect more patterns and give you richer health insights.

fields.title: Chief of Staff Consolidation — One Interface, Zero Confusion
fields.description: The standalone Assistant page has been retired. Your Chief of Staff now lives exclusively in the persistent chat panel available on every page — no need to navigate away to talk to it. Today's Priorities are now a dashboard tile you can customize, reorder, and resize alongside your other tiles. All navigation has been rebranded from 'Assistant' to 'Chief of Staff' for consistency. The alignment badge and nav links now go to CoS Settings where you can manage your Chief of Staff preferences.

fields.title: A Real Introduction — Your CoS Gets to Know You First
fields.description: Your Chief of Staff now has a proper introduction flow. Instead of jumping straight into task management, it starts by learning about YOU — your priorities, routines, who matters most, and how you want to be held accountable. It already knows your data (weight, goals, journals, habits) and uses that to ask informed questions, not generic ones. The conversation is open-ended: come back over multiple sessions to share more, pause anytime, and finish whenever you're ready by clicking 'I'm Ready — Let's Work.' During the introduction, the CoS listens and absorbs — it won't log data or take actions until you tell it you're done getting acquainted.

fields.title: Your Chief of Staff Now Knows Your Schedule
fields.description: Your Chief of Staff now has full calendar awareness. When you say 'Good morning', it checks your schedule and responds like a real executive assistant — referencing upcoming events, noting if you're running behind, and proactively offering to reschedule. Calendar events appear in the CoS context with real-time status: [NOW] for in-progress, [SOON] for upcoming within the hour, and [MISSED] for events whose start time has passed. Additionally, the NLP quick-add parser now properly cleans event titles — 'Pickleball tomorrow at 6pm' correctly creates an event titled 'Pickleball' instead of 'Pickleball tomorrow at'.

fields.title: Smart Quick Links with Mobile App Deep Linking
fields.description: Quick Links now support mobile app deep linking. When you add a link, you can optionally set a mobile app URL (like chase:// or bofa://). On your phone, the link will try to open the app first — if it is not installed, it automatically opens the website instead. Links also now track usage, support categories (Finance, Health, Work, etc.), and include an edit button for quick updates. Set up your links in Preferences under Quick Links.

fields.title: Smarter Voice Command Recognition
fields.description: Your Chief of Staff now better understands a wider range of voice commands. Fitness logging ('I did 10 pushups and 20 squats'), goal setting ('I want to lose 30 pounds'), habit tracking ('completed my morning routine'), faith actions ('God answered my prayer'), and calendar scheduling all have improved recognition. Commands that involve times — like 'I ate lunch 3 hours ago' or 'I worked out this morning' — now correctly backdate the entry. Additionally, your CoS can now direct you to Medical Records, Brain Training, Capture, Scan, and Finance pages.

fields.title: Chief of Staff Calendar Scheduling Fix
fields.description: Fixed a bug where your Chief of Staff would schedule calendar events on the wrong date when you said 'tomorrow' or 'today'. The AI now knows the current date and correctly resolves relative dates. Calendar event examples have been improved so your CoS better understands scheduling requests.

fields.title: Smarter Chief of Staff After Getting to Know You
fields.description: Your Chief of Staff now retains the same warmth and attentiveness from the Getting to Know You conversation into everyday use. It reflects back what you share, connects your requests to what it already knows about you, and understands context before acting — the same personality, now with the ability to execute your requests.

fields.title: Calendar Manage Events Improvements
fields.description: The Manage Events page now has a '+ New Event' button so you can create calendar events directly. Table rows are clickable to edit, and Edit/Delete actions use compact icon buttons that stay visible without scrolling. On mobile, events display as cards with actions always accessible at the bottom of each card.

fields.title: Time Command Center
fields.description: Your Chief of Staff now has a unified calendar. See all your tasks, goals, and habits projected onto a single timeline with Today, 3-Day, Week, and Agenda views. Drag events to reschedule — task deadlines update automatically. The Habit Protection Layer warns you before scheduling over protected time like workouts. Smart Gap Detection suggests where to fit in execution time for items due soon. The Domain Imbalance Bar shows how your time is split across Faith, Health, Family, and Work. Quick-add events with natural language like 'Bible Study Wednesdays 6pm-8pm'.

fields.title: Always-On Chief of Staff Chat
fields.description: Your Chief of Staff is now always available in the right panel on every page. The side panel has been replaced with a persistent chat interface — type or speak to your CoS anytime without navigating away. When calibration is active, the chat opens automatically and starts the conversation. Switch to the Status tab to see your daily plan, drift alerts, and quick actions. On mobile, pull up the chat drawer from the bottom of any page.

fields.title: Chief of Staff Gets to Know You
fields.description: Your Chief of Staff now conducts a real getting-to-know-you conversation when you first start using it. Instead of asking one question per day over two weeks, it walks through a series of questions about your priorities, non-negotiables, preferred activities, and accountability style in a natural back-and-forth conversation. Say 'enough for now' at any time to pause, and it picks up where you left off next time.

fields.title: Chief of Staff Assistant
fields.description: Your new Life Operating System layer. Set up your Personal Operating Blueprint to define your identity-protected behaviors, life pillars, and operating style. The assistant builds a daily architecture plan each night, detects drift from your commitments, and intervenes at the right escalation level. A desktop pinned panel and mobile pull-up give you plan-at-a-glance, drift status, and quick actions throughout the day.

fields.title: Nutrition Log Upgrade
fields.description: Major upgrade to the nutrition tracker. Browse between days with date navigation arrows. Copy individual food entries, entire meals, or full days to other dates. Save frequently-eaten meals as reusable templates. See where your nutrition data comes from with source badges (FatSecret, AI, Saved, etc.). Enjoy a polished mobile experience with sticky daily totals, improved forms, and better accessibility.

fields.title: Body Transformation Protocol
fields.description: Track your body transformation journey with a complete intelligence pipeline. Set up transformation protocols (cut, bulk, recomp, maintenance), track nutrition compliance, fasting consistency, workout frequency, and strength progress. The AI monitors your transformation score across all domains and provides proactive coaching, predictions, and guidance. View your transformation dashboard with trend charts for weight, body fat, calories, protein, fasting, and workouts.

fields.title: Shopping Lists
fields.description: Create and manage shopping lists to support your nutrition and transformation goals. Add items with quantities and categories (produce, protein, dairy, grains, frozen, pantry, beverages, supplements), mark items as purchased, and track your shopping progress. Ask the AI to add items or complete them hands-free.

fields.title: AI Insights Inbox
fields.description: Your AI assistant now proactively generates insights about your health, goals, habits, scripture reading, and journaling patterns. Get notified about weight trends, approaching deadlines, broken habit streaks, and more. View all insights in your new Insights Inbox, where you can filter by status and mark them as read or dismissed.

fields.title: Smarter AI: Time Understanding & Memory
fields.description: The AI assistant now understands natural language time expressions like '3 days ago', 'next Friday at 2pm', and 'last month on the 15th'. It also learns from your clarifications — the more you use it, the better it understands your preferences.

fields.title: Goal Engine: Measurement-Driven Habits
fields.description: Habit goals now support four measurement types: Binary (daily check-off), Duration (timed sessions with built-in timer), Count (track repetitions), and Target (hit numeric goals). Each type gets its own logging UI, progress tracking, and analytics. Existing habits continue working unchanged. Find them under Goals > Habits.

fields.title: Habit Streaks & Smart Insights
fields.description: Track your habit streaks with daily, weekly, or monthly frequency. Get smart insights when you hit milestones (7, 30, 90 days), when completion rates are unusually high or low, and when day-of-week patterns emerge. Insights can be applied or dismissed. View your streak on the habit detail page and dashboard tile.

fields.title: Clickable Habit Calendar & Undo
fields.description: Click any day on your habit's progress matrix or calendar to instantly log it. Use Shift+Click for date ranges and Ctrl/Cmd+Click for multi-select. Every action shows an undo toast with an 8-second countdown so you can reverse mistakes instantly.

fields.title: Labs & Vitals
fields.description: Upload lab result PDFs and get automatic parsing of blood work panels. View results with color-coded flags (normal, high, low), track trends over time with charts, and learn what each test measures with built-in education content. Find it under Health > Labs & Vitals.

fields.title: Lab Test Education
fields.description: Tap the info icon next to any lab test to learn what it measures, what high or low values may indicate, and what factors can influence results. Education content available for all 57 standard lab tests. Includes required medical disclaimers.

fields.title: Quick Links
fields.description: Save your frequently used external links (patient portal, bank login, etc.) and access them from the profile dropdown menu. Add up to 10 links in Preferences > Quick Links. Links open in a new tab.

fields.title: Smarter AI Assistant
fields.description: The AI assistant now threads conversations naturally, remembers what you discussed earlier in the chat, and gives data-driven answers instead of generic advice. It can read your recent journal entries to answer date-specific questions like 'how was I feeling last Tuesday?'

fields.title: Scroll Position Preserved
fields.description: Pages with repeated actions (medicine doses, task checkboxes, prayer answers, water logging) no longer jump to the top after each action. Your scroll position is saved and restored automatically.

fields.title: New Character Study: Daniel
fields.description: Explore Daniel: Faith in Exile - a 12-day journey through the Book of Daniel. Study Daniel's faithfulness in Babylon, the fiery furnace, the lions' den, and prophetic visions. Available in Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced levels. Find it under Faith > Reading Plans.

fields.title: Recurring Transactions
fields.description: Track subscriptions, bills, and regular income automatically. Set up recurring transactions with flexible frequencies (daily to yearly), auto-post or reminder-only modes, and view upcoming bills on your finance dashboard. Find it under Finance > Recurring.

fields.title: Sleep Tracking
fields.description: Track your sleep with detailed logging or quick entry. Log bedtime, wake time, quality rating, and sleep stages. View your sleep history with charts and averages. Designed for future wearable sync with Apple Health, Fitbit, and more. Find it under Health > Sleep.

fields.title: Dashboard Weather Widget
fields.description: Your dashboard now shows current weather conditions and a 3-day forecast. Get prominent alerts for extreme heat, cold, high winds, or severe weather. Set your location in Preferences to enable this feature.

fields.title: Inline Scripture in Reading Plans
fields.description: Scripture references in reading plans now expand inline when clicked. Read verses without leaving your current page. Click again to collapse. Uses your preferred Bible translation from settings.

fields.title: Menstrual Cycle Tracking
fields.description: Comprehensive cycle tracking with daily logging for flow, symptoms, mood, and energy. AI-powered predictions for your next period and fertile window. View cycle statistics, trends, and phase information. Auto-enabled for female users during onboarding.

fields.title: Dexcom CGM Integration
fields.description: Connect your Dexcom CGM account to automatically sync blood glucose readings. View current glucose with trend arrows, time-in-range stats, 24-hour charts, and automatic background syncing.

fields.title: Barcode Scanner for Food
fields.description: Scan food product barcodes with your phone camera for instant nutrition info. Lookup uses local database first, then AI for unknown products. Pre-fills your food entry form with all nutritional data.

fields.title: AI Camera Scanning
fields.description: Point your phone at food, medicine, documents, or workout equipment and let AI identify it and suggest actions. Supports 8 categories with smart routing to the right module.

fields.title: Medicine Tracking
fields.description: Comprehensive medicine management with daily tracker, schedules, adherence stats, refill alerts, and PRN support. One-tap check-off for doses.

fields.title: Nutrition & Food Tracking
fields.description: Log meals with macro tracking, daily summaries, and nutrition goals. Includes custom foods, meal type categorization, and eating context tracking.

fields.title: Enhanced Dashboard
fields.description: Dashboard now shows Today's Medicine Schedule with status badges, Recent Workouts with PR highlights, and Quick Stats for medicine doses and workout counts.

fields.title: AI Camera Source Tracking
fields.description: Entries created via AI Camera now show a camera badge on detail pages. Track which entries came from AI-powered scanning.

fields.title: Security Improvements
fields.description: Enhanced security with rate limiting, secure admin URL, improved cookie settings, and server-side API key handling for Bible lookups.

fields.title: Onboarding Wizard
fields.description: New users are guided through a friendly 6-step wizard to personalize their experience - choose theme, enable modules, configure AI coaching, and set location.

fields.title: Scripture Library
fields.description: Save, edit, and organize your favorite Scripture verses in a personal library. Add themes and personal notes to each verse.

fields.title: AI Coaching Styles
fields.description: Choose how the AI communicates with you. Pick from 7 styles including Supportive Partner, Direct Coach, Gentle Guide, and more.

fields.title: Task Undo
fields.description: Accidentally marked a task complete? Now you can easily undo with a single click using the new Undo link.

fields.title: Fitness Tracking
fields.description: Track workouts, log exercises, and monitor your fitness journey with comprehensive workout logging.

fields.title: Journal Prompts
fields.description: 20 curated writing prompts across 8 categories to inspire your daily reflections. Get a random prompt with one click.

fields.title: Life Module
fields.description: Manage your whole life with Projects, Tasks, Calendar, Inventory, Pets, Recipes, Maintenance logs, and Document storage.

fields.title: Purpose Module
fields.description: Set your annual direction with Word of the Year, life goals, change intentions, and seasonal reflections.

fields.title: Body Composition Tracking
fields.description: Track body fat %, lean mass, measurements, and more from gym scans or smart scales. Flexible metric storage supports unlimited measurement types. Find it under Health > Body Composition.

fields.title: Health Insights Engine
fields.description: A new cross-domain insight engine analyzes patterns across weight, body composition, goals, habits, and journal entries. Generates observational insights like trends, consistency patterns, and logging gaps. Find it under Health > Insights.

fields.title: Today's Guidance on Your Dashboard
fields.description: Your dashboard now shows personalized guidance items — evidence-based insights, warnings, and encouragement generated from your health trends, goal progress, and life patterns. Quickly act on suggestions, snooze them for later, or dismiss items you don't need.

fields.title: Enhanced Guidance Inbox
fields.description: The Guidance Inbox now lets you filter by lifecycle state — view active, acknowledged, dismissed, snoozed, and acted items. Each card shows source badges, priority indicators, confidence scores for predictions, and lifecycle timestamps. Manage your guidance with inline actions directly from the inbox.

fields.title: Your Current State on the Dashboard
fields.description: A new dashboard tile shows exactly what WLJ knows about you — your current weight, sleep, steps, goals, habits, journal activity, and faith data. All values come directly from the State Awareness Engine, giving you full transparency into the data that powers your insights and guidance.

fields.title: Daily Briefing on Your Dashboard
fields.description: A new Daily Briefing tile summarizes the most important intelligence from your data each day. It combines insights, predictions, and guidance into one concise summary — so you can start your day informed.

fields.title: Weekly Intelligence Reports
fields.description: A new Weekly Intelligence Report summarizes your state changes, insights, predictions, and guidance engagement over the past week. View your latest report on the dashboard or browse all historical reports.

fields.title: Evidence & Explainability Engine
fields.description: Every intelligence output now has a "Why?" link explaining what data drove the recommendation, with evidence links and confidence assessments. See it on guidance cards, daily briefings, and weekly reports.

fields.title: Intelligence Notifications
fields.description: WLJ now proactively delivers guidance, daily briefings, and weekly reports via an in-app notification bell. Configure quiet hours and rate limits to control when and how often you receive intelligence notifications.

fields.title: Intelligence Command Center
fields.description: A unified intelligence dashboard that brings together your current state, active guidance, daily briefing, weekly report, predictions, and delivery history — all in one place with explainability links.

fields.title: Intelligence Quality Gate (ICQG)
fields.description: Your intelligence system now includes a quality gate that reduces repetitive guidance, detects conflicting signals, and tracks usefulness metrics. Guidance repeats are suppressed for 72 hours (unless severity increases), and conflicting data points are merged into clear 'mixed signals' summaries.

fields.title: Push Notifications for Intelligence
fields.description: You can now receive intelligence guidance, daily briefings, and weekly reports as push notifications on your iOS device. Enable push in the iOS app Settings, then turn on the Push toggle in your web Notification Settings. Push notifications respect your quiet hours, and critical alerts can bypass quiet hours when needed.

fields.title: Adaptive Coaching Personas
fields.description: Your coaching style now intelligently adapts to your context and responsiveness. Guidance, daily briefings, and weekly reports are rendered in your chosen persona voice — with tone intensity that adjusts based on how you engage with guidance, the urgency of the message, and your current state. All 14 coaching styles are supported.

fields.title: Intelligence Observability Dashboard
fields.description: Staff administrators now have access to the Intelligence Observability Dashboard, providing daily metrics snapshots on guidance effectiveness, prediction confidence, delivery performance, user engagement, system quality, and persona effectiveness. Includes 7-day trend indicators and automatic daily snapshots via the scheduler.

fields.title: Admin Guide: System Documentation
fields.description: A comprehensive Admin Guide is now available in the Admin Console. It provides detailed documentation of the WLJ system architecture, all 14 intelligence engines, modules, security, deployment, and developer reference — organized across 20 sections with full technical and operational coverage.

fields.title: Voice Conversation Mode
fields.description: Talk to your AI assistant hands-free. Click the microphone to start a voice conversation — the mic stays active through the full speak, AI responds, text-to-speech, speak again cycle. No more stopping and starting between each message. Works in both the Chief of Staff command mode and the chat widget. The AI responds conversationally when you speak, and you can choose your preferred text-to-speech voice.

fields.title: Relationship Tracking
fields.description: Keep important relationships healthy with automatic interaction tracking. The system learns who matters to you from your journal entries and reflections, tracks when you last connected, and gently nudges you when it has been too long. View your tracked relationships in Chief of Staff Settings with importance tiers and contact cadence targets.

fields.title: Workout Plans & Training Splits
fields.description: Organize your training with structured workout plans. Group your workout templates into named programs, assign them to specific days of the week with preferred times, and follow a consistent training split. Link plans to your transformation protocol for integrated progress tracking.

fields.title: Post-Event Reflection Check-ins
fields.description: After significant events like work meetings, social gatherings, or workouts, your Chief of Staff queues a brief morning check-in. Answer a few quick questions about how it went, capture action items, or skip if it is not relevant. Reflections appear in your command mode panel and can be toggled on or off in CoS Settings.

fields.title: Smart Scheduling with Conflict Detection
fields.description: When you create events through the AI assistant, it now checks for conflicts with your protected commitments and warns you before double-booking. Your daily capacity automatically updates and new events sync to Google Calendar if connected.

fields.title: Smarter Intelligence — Instant Feedback on Every Entry
fields.description: Your intelligence engines now respond to every action you take. Log a weight entry, complete a habit, write a journal entry, or finish a scripture reading and you’ll get instant feedback — including a special first-entry celebration when you start tracking a new area. Thresholds have been removed so even small changes generate insights and predictions. The system no longer waits for weeks of data before helping you.

fields.title: Chat Timestamps & Date Grouping
fields.description: Every message in your Chief of Staff chat now shows the time it was sent (e.g. 2:30 PM). When scrolling back through your conversation history, date separators appear at each day boundary showing Today, Yesterday, or the full date. Makes it easy to see when each interaction happened.

fields.title: Smarter, More Conversational Chief of Staff
fields.description: Your Chief of Staff just got a major intelligence upgrade. Powered by GPT-4o (up from GPT-4o-mini), it now understands nuance, reads between the lines, and responds with genuine warmth instead of generic answers. The internal prompt architecture was rebuilt so personality and relationship instructions take priority over operational data. Conversations should feel noticeably more natural and perceptive.

fields.title: Improved Startup Reliability & Resilience
fields.description: The app now starts faster and more reliably. Heavy data loading has been moved out of the startup path, Redis failures are handled gracefully with automatic recovery, and all fixture data is validated before deployment to prevent configuration errors from causing outages.

fields.title: People List: Select All & Bulk Actions
fields.description: Select multiple contacts with checkboxes and take action on them all at once. Use the new Select All checkbox to pick everyone on the page, or check individual contacts. A floating action bar appears with options to create a journal entry, add a prayer, or create a group from your selection.

fields.title: Batch Import: Pick Multiple Phone Contacts at Once
fields.description: No more importing contacts one at a time. The iOS contact picker now supports multi-select — tap all the contacts you want, press Done, and they all import with a progress bar. A summary shows how many were added, already existed, or failed. Tap Import More to grab another batch without leaving the screen.

fields.title: Export Workout Dashboard to Excel
fields.description: Download a full workout dashboard as an Excel file right from the Fitness page. The workbook includes 7 sheets: summary stats with charts, workout history, exercise details with every set and rep, cardio and classes, personal records with estimated 1RM, steps and activity, and exercise progress over time.

fields.title: Ask Your Chief of Staff for Any Report
fields.description: Just ask and she'll build it. Say something like 'create me a workout report', 'export my sleep data to Excel', or 'send me a health overview dashboard' and your Chief of Staff will generate a formatted Excel workbook and email it to you. Supports 14 report types: workouts, sleep, weight, steps, heart rate, blood pressure, blood oxygen, glucose, medicine adherence, fasting, hydration, nutrition, body composition, and a combined health overview.

fields.title: Guides Hub: Data Dictionary & User Guide
fields.description: The Admin Console now has a dedicated Guides section with three guides: Admin Guide (system docs), Data Dictionary (complete database reference with tables, fields, and engine mappings), and User Guide (how-to documentation built from help topics). The User Guide is also accessible from the profile dropdown menu for all users.

fields.title: Friendlier Chat Error Recovery
fields.description: When your Chief of Staff hits a hiccup, she now responds with a friendly message and a one-tap retry button instead of a cold error screen. Messages rotate so you never see the same one twice, and the tone gently shifts if the issue persists.

fields.title: Proactive Daily Executive Briefing
fields.description: Your Chief of Staff now greets you with a personalized executive briefing when you open the chat — your goals, today’s tasks, overdue items, workout status, and a clear recommendation for where to start. No need to ask — she delivers intelligence automatically.

fields.title: Smarter Pattern Awareness
fields.description: Your Chief of Staff now tracks your behavioral patterns over time — workout consistency, weight tracking, journaling, medication adherence, and more. Your Chief of Staff can distinguish a single missed day from a real habit break, reinforce your momentum when you’re consistent, and respectfully call out drift when a declared priority slips. Priorities are fully personalized — your Chief of Staff uses your calibration profile, governance settings, and declared non-negotiables to know what matters most to you.

fields.title: Projected A1C is now honestly labeled — and reads your trend, not just your number
fields.description: Your Mission card's Projected A1C is an estimate calculated from your CGM glucose data using the industry-standard GMI formula (the same one used by the ADA and Dexcom) — it is not a laboratory A1C, and the app now makes that clear at every step. High-confidence readings show the number with an "Estimated from CGM data" note, and recent-data estimates read "Using recent available glucose data" — no more overstating precision. The bigger change is how the metric is classified: it now weighs both your current level and your trend together, so an in-range number that's drifting the wrong way is shown as "Worth Watching" rather than quietly celebrated. That avoids false reassurance and tells you the truth about your trajectory. We also fixed the Nutrition link on your Mission card so it opens your nutrition page directly.

fields.title: Your Mission card now reflects journal and nutrition entries right away
fields.description: When you write a journal entry or log a meal, your Mission card now updates within moments instead of waiting until the next day. Previously these signals could lag behind — you might log dinner and still see "0% macros," or journal in the morning and still see "0/wk" — which left you wondering whether your entry actually saved. The dashboard now checks for your latest journal and nutrition activity as it loads and refreshes just those signals if they're behind, so what you see matches what you just did. It's a targeted, lightweight refresh that keeps the rest of the dashboard fast.

fields.title: Forgot to check off a routine? Routine History lets you set the record straight
fields.description: If you did your prayer time, workout, or evening journaling but forgot to mark it complete, your adherence used to count it as missed — and your Chief of Staff coached from that wrong data. The new Routine History screen fixes that. Open it from the History link on the Routines page, pick any past day with the arrows or date picker, and mark items you actually did — choosing "On time" or "Late" so the record stays truthful. You can also skip an item or undo a mistaken completion. Anything you log after the fact is clearly badged "Corrected later" instead of a clean real-time "Completed," so your genuine in-the-moment consistency stays distinguishable from later catch-up. Corrections flow into your streaks, adherence score, and your Chief of Staff's understanding immediately.

fields.title: Your Executive Briefing now tells you the single smartest move — not just a pattern
fields.description: The "Biggest Opportunity" tile used to describe a pattern in your data ("recovery is needed"). Now it names the one highest-leverage thing to do — a clear action plus a one-line why, like "Prioritize sleep tonight — better sleep lifts your energy, recovery, and glucose all at once." When several things need attention, it surfaces the move that lifts the most areas at once (sleep and recovery rank highest because they improve everything downstream), so you always know the smartest next step rather than a list. We also fixed a glitch where "Recommended Focus" could show the same suggestion two or three times — recommendations are now de-duplicated and ranked by value, so you only ever see distinct, useful focuses.

fields.title: Your Chief of Staff answers day-planning and health questions even if the AI is briefly busy
fields.description: Questions your Chief of Staff already has the facts to answer — "what needs my attention?", "help me plan the rest of my day", "wrap up my day", "give me a health summary", "how is my diabetes doing?" — now always get a real answer drawn from your own data, even in the rare moments the AI service is briefly unavailable. You’ll no longer hit a "try again later" message for things we can answer directly. General-knowledge questions phrased in the abstract ("what is a healthy weight generally?") are also answered as general information and never mistaken for a question about your personal numbers.

fields.title: Say “Good morning” and your Chief of Staff gives you a real morning briefing
fields.description: Greeting your Chief of Staff — “Good morning”, “start my day”, “how is my day looking?” — now always returns a real briefing of your day drawn from your own schedule and priorities, even in the rare moments the AI service is briefly busy. You’ll never get a “try again later” message for your morning check-in. Questions about a specific goal (“what comes next on my mission?”, “am I behind?”, “what could derail me today?”) now land on the right answer more reliably, even when phrased loosely.

fields.title: Your Chief of Staff now checks in before briefing you — and fixes its answer when you push back
fields.description: Mornings now start like a real Chief of Staff would: instead of immediately listing your day, your assistant greets you, notes a thing or two from overnight (like how you slept), and asks how you’re doing before getting into the agenda — and it holds the briefing until you answer. If you tell it you’re running low, it keeps the briefing lighter. And when you push back on something it said — “does that sound right?”, “that wasn’t quite right” — it now recognizes you’re questioning its last answer, re-checks it instead of changing the subject, and offers to correct it. All of this works even if the AI service is briefly busy.

fields.title: Your morning briefing now reads like a real Chief of Staff
fields.description: When your Chief of Staff briefs you, it no longer starts with a list of tasks. It now opens with where you stand, an honest read on the day (a strong day, a recovery day, a heavier one), what actually matters, your biggest risk, and the single highest-leverage move — and only then the agenda, which is supporting detail, never the headline. If you tell it you're running low, the read adapts. And if you push back that a reply wasn't up to standard, it owns the miss, names what went wrong, and re-briefs you properly instead of asking you to explain what was off.

fields.title: Your briefing now reads like a conversation, not a report
fields.description: Your Chief of Staff no longer hands you a list of labeled sections. It tells you one clear story: what today actually is, the one thing that matters most and why, what you can safely let wait, and how the afternoon looks — woven together the way a trusted advisor would say it out loud. It leads with the conclusion, only brings up the supporting detail when it strengthens the advice, and reconciles conflicts (if you're running low, it tells you to keep the workout light rather than just listing it). It now adds judgment and clarity your dashboard can't.

fields.title: Add a medication by taking a few photos
fields.description: Adding a medication or supplement now feels like scanning a document, not filling out a form. Choose what you're adding — a prescription bottle, a supplement, an over-the-counter medicine, or an injection pen — and you'll be guided photo by photo: the front of the bottle, the pharmacy label, the Supplement or Drug Facts. You can take several pictures, and they're combined into one richer reading than any single photo could give. If something is still hard to read, you'll get a plain explanation of exactly which picture would help — for example, “to improve confidence, I'd like a photo of the pharmacy label.” You can skip optional steps, retake or remove a photo, drag and drop images on your computer, and finish whenever you're ready. Nothing is saved until you review the extracted details and confirm. Barcode scanning and manual entry are still there whenever you prefer them.
